doc.markdown:
Fill the destination from the system provider and return its exact length.
Provider/allocation failures retain their runtime boundary. Empty requests
preserve the existing provider check. The temporary owned draw is released.

doc.markdown:
Copy only after a successful exact read, returning the advanced continuation.
This operation does not copy partial failures into destination; the callback
remains responsible for its own mutations. Empty reads invoke no callback.
Uniform cryptographic bytes remain the caller's duty.

doc.markdown:
Fill after a complete raw-source draw, retaining its data/status-aware handle.
Private prefix storage is discarded on failure. A final full prefix suppresses
its simultaneous status. The callback remains responsible for its own mutations.

Owned-buffer filling with an explicit cryptographic source capability.
The default always uses system entropy. Reader-based filling is explicit and
has only the quality of its supplied source; no mutable global source exists.
